initial_application: The Jira comments say the change was applied in svn 13314. Migrated Git history has no commit message mentioning FHIR-13914, and current source searches find no active core build-input occurrence of codesystem-reference. Historical release snapshots still preserve the old STU3 definition, but those are release-history artifacts rather than current build source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes source/datatypes/coding-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for Coding extensions, and that current build input has no codesystem-reference match. Current terminology narrative refers to valueset-reference only. The FHIR Extension Pack contains StructureDefinition-valueset-reference scoped to Coding and no codesystem-reference file, confirming that only the non-duplicate sibling extension remains. Vocab WG Confluence minutes and the block vote page corroborate the 2018-02-22 7-0-0 block-vote disposition; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the current core build surface already reflects the requested removal, and changing historical snapshots or the surviving valueset-reference extension would be inappropriate.
